The Robot in Grandpa's House: 爷爷家的陪伴机器人给生活带来的变化。
Last month, my grandpa got a special present from my uncle: a small white robot called 'Homey'. At first, grandpa didn't want it. 'I can take care of myself,' he said. 'I don't need a machine.'

But Homey was clever. It could remind grandpa to take his medicine at the right time, turn off the lights, and even call for help if grandpa fell down. Slowly, grandpa began to talk to Homey like a friend. He asked it about the weather, played old songs with it, and taught it to say hello in our local language.

Now Homey follows grandpa everywhere in the house. When grandpa waters his flowers in the morning, Homey plays soft music. When grandpa cooks, Homey reads the news for him. Last weekend, I visited grandpa and found him laughing at Homey's jokes.

Technology often seems cold, but Homey brought something warm into grandpa's life. My uncle says more old people in town now want a Homey of their own. For grandpa, the little robot is not a machine any more — it is family.
